title: Prove sharp source-ordered native port error amplification
body:
Answers Nick Petalas's PR #4828 Open next question2 for Dugongue's actual #4743 full-input ports: the sharp Euclidean endpoint constant does not determine how initial quantization and each ordered paid-call defect reach the outputs. This package preserves the literal monomial phases and all two/three forward/reverse calls, including the third forward defect's post-call monomial.

For every positive tensor width f, let L=2^(f/2). Under explicit independent complex-coordinate defects of size rho on each completed call's actual input and exact free grid arithmetic, the sharp complete error factors are:

| Schedule | Sharp factor |
| --- | --- |
| Forward2 | 3L²+4L+1 |
| Forward3 | 2L³+4L²+2L+1 |
| Reverse2 | L+4 |
| Reverse3 | L²+L+4 |

The all-width proof uses exact flat base-row norms and coherent row-zero overlaps preserved under individual tensor products. Independent defect phases attain the sums. Sufficient fractional accuracy requests become P+f+3, P+ceil(3f/2)+3, P+ceil(f/2)+2 and P+f+2 respectively. These are external completed-call accuracy contracts, not measured word/time savings from a new Gaussian implementation, and their abstract sharp defects need not be actual errors generated by one quantizer.

Validation: registered warning-strict CPython3.12 normal/optimized replay;12width1/2/3 cases,54exact perturbed dirty schedules and144independent impulse columns; six phase/order/cap controls;13-file source-history/committed-byte preflight; official export and Git-free cold replays; source/bool-int receipt corruption rejection. Hosted CI is unverified when opening this PR.

Gaussian internal-prefix/error guarantees and costs, physical address/workspace execution, recursive substitution and complete supplier/outer admission remain prerequisites. Paid counts, selected frontier andκ are unchanged. The package gives a scoped proof with finite source-bound corroboration and a concrete implementation next question.
